subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Drone Delivery at Scale
description: A fast breakdown of Drone Delivery at Scale for builders.

hook.text: A drone lifts off from a Walmart rooftop and drops a prescription at a house 3 miles away in 8 minutes.

buildup.text: Delivery drones bypass roads entirely, flying direct routes to deliver lightweight packages at high speed.

discovery.text: They excel for urgent, small deliveries: medicines, food, and convenience items under 5 pounds.

twist.text: Airspace regulation, battery limits, and noise complaints restrict where and when drones can fly.

climax.text: Wing, Zipline, and Amazon are scaling drone delivery in select markets—tens of thousands of flights weekly.

punchline.text: Skip the road. Fly direct. That's drone delivery.

quiz.question: What types of deliveries are drones best suited for?
